name: ottplay-roku
description: OTTPlay native BrightScript and SceneGraph client for Roku

scripts.test: node tests/toolchain.cjs && node scripts/test-brightscript.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.build: npm run check && python3 scripts/package.py build
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && python3 scripts/package.py verify
